map.D 对波速差 (Vp−Vs) 极敏感。若把 Vs 估高，分母变小会显著夸大震中距: D is highly sensitive to the velocity difference (Vp−Vs). If Vs is overestimated the denominator shrinks and the epicentral distance is greatly exaggerated; look the value up from the rock type beneath the station, since sedimentary basins and bedrock areas differ markedly.
map.Vp/Vs 取错影响多大？: How much does a wrong Vp/Vs matter?
Δt is the arrival-time difference between the S and P waves, and Vp, Vs are the longitudinal and transverse wave velocities; D / 111.32 converts kilometres into angular distance (1° ≈ 111.32 km).

map.为什么结果只是近似？: Why is the result only an approximation?
map.公式假设震源到台站为均匀介质、波沿直线传播。真实地壳波速随深度变化且射线弯曲，故: The formula assumes a homogeneous medium from source to station with straight-ray propagation. Real crustal velocities vary with depth and rays bend, so the single-station time-difference method yields only an approximate straight-line distance to the epicentre; precise location needs at least three stations intersecting.

map.震中距 D = Δt × Vp × Vs / (Vp − Vs)；角距 = D: Epicentral distance D = Δt x Vp x Vs / (Vp - Vs); angular distance = D / 111.32; P wave travel distance = Δt x Vp
map.：例：Δt=20s、Vp=6.0km/s、Vs=3.5km/s → D=20×6: : Example: Δt=20s, Vp=6.0km/s, Vs=3.5km/s gives D=20x6.0x3.5/(6.0-3.5)=420/2.5=168.00km and angular distance=168/111.32=1.51°. With Δt=30s and the same velocities, D=252.00km and the angular distance=2.26°. Note that using regional average velocities makes the result approximate: in hard rock areas a higher Vp maps the same Δt to a larger epicentral distance.
map.：算法：震中距 D = Δt·Vp·Vs/(Vp−Vs)，其中 Δt 为 S 波: : algorithm: epicentral distance D = Δt·Vp·Vs/(Vp−Vs), where Δt is the S minus P arrival time difference and Vp, Vs are the P and S wave velocities (default Vp=6.0, Vs=3.5 km/s). The angular distance (great-circle distance) = D/111.32 (°), where 111.32 km is the approximate surface arc of 1°. Requires Δt>0 and Vp>Vs>0.
